title: Abelian inverse-image global sections and set section comparisons
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $F$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Write $F_{set}$ for its underlying set sheaf and $1_X$ for the terminal etale object. For every $f:Y\to X$, there are simultaneous bijections $e_f:\Gamma(Y,f^{-1}F)\simeq(f^{-1}F_{set})(Y\times_X1_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For every commuting triangle $Z\xrightarrow{h}Y\xrightarrow{f}X$ with $k=hf$, and every $s\in\Gamma(Y,f^{-1}F)$, these satisfy $e_k(\Gamma(\alpha^{-1})(h^*s))=r_{h,f,k}(e_f(s))$, where $\alpha:k^{-1}F\simeq h^{-1}f^{-1}F$ is the canonical composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] and $r$ is the canonical set section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison]. No inverse system, limit, affine, qcqs, torsion, or finite-stage lifting hypothesis or assertion is involved.

proof.text: Construct the set-to-abelian coefficient comparison as the set adjunction mate of the forgotten abelian unit. Use the coefficient hom-set equation and the sectionwise identity direct-image comparison from etaleInverseImageAlgebraicStructures to identify this fixed morphism with the inverse coefficient isomorphism. Consequently it is invertible; no arbitrary witness is used to define its data.

The abelian composition unit equation follows from upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app. Use the existing public etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits theorem directly for the chosen set composition unit equation; extensionality converts this sectionwise equality to a morphism equality without a duplicate set_comp_unit declaration. Apply injectivity of the set adjunction hom-set bijection to show that the two forgotten transition morphisms agree, using their unit equations and naturality of the direct-image composition isomorphism.

Evaluate the inverse coefficient isomorphism at the pullback of any etale object to obtain the section equivalence. Evaluate the transition identity, and use naturality along the fibre-product pasting isomorphism to obtain the section comparison equation. Transport a commuting triangle by its equality.

For each f, compose GammaNatIsoSheafSections with restriction along PreservesTerminal.iso(f.Etale).hom and the proved section equivalence at the terminal object. For compatibility, expand globalSectionsUpperStarMap, apply GammaNatIsoSheafSections naturality, cancel its inverse, then use naturality of the abelian unit and inverse composition morphism. The two maps from the composite base-changed terminal object to the terminal object agree by terminal uniqueness. This gives the required equality without additional hypotheses.

theorem exists_abelianPullbackGlobalSectionsComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X),
      ((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F)) ≃
      (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj
        ((sheafForget X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F)).obj.obj
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj (⊤_ X.Etale)))),
      ∀ (Y Z : Scheme.{u}) (h : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) (k : Z ⟶ X)
        (hk : h ≫ f = k)
        (s : (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F)),
        e Z k ((Sheaf.Γ Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h f k hk.symm).inv.app F)
          (globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F) s)) =
        etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk
          ((sheafForget X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) (⊤_ X.Etale) (e Y f s)
